svg.title: #115 + #170 + 7460/7490 Herndon Rd (same owner), South Fulton
svg.text: rear-load 310 deep, court + trailer row, cars along office wall
Trailer stalls 58 (court rows 58, drop yard 0) vs target 58
Site 77.6 ac (county map) 3,800 SF/gross ac FAR 0.09
Detention 4.9 ac-ft in 0 pond(s) - see flags
Access: truck (T) + car (C); local road, GDOT route 1121200064200;
Graded area: relief ~82 ft, balanced cut/fill ~158,000 CY, steep
!! ROUTE_INFEASIBLE: no truck route inside the paving envelope
from the driveway to the court
!! CAR_ROUTE_NONE: no car route from a driveway to the car field
corridor widths assumed by voltage; no building or pond under the
lines, paving only with the utility's consent
! RESIDENTIAL_EDGE: about 7,611 ft of boundary touches residential
parcels (county land-use codes); draft buffers applied
! FIRE_SECOND_ACCESS: driveways 254 ft apart, under half the
! POND_DOES_NOT_FIT: 1 pond(s) of 4.9 ac-ft do not fit on the
development side: underground detention (vaults) or a smaller
! LOADING_FACES_RES: a truck court or trailer row is within 150 ft
of a residential edge (50 ft loading strip and screening likely)
! GRADING_RISK: 16% of the graded area is steeper than 15% (lidar)
! RELIEF: about 82 ft of relief across the graded area: terraces
! ZONING_DRAFT: setbacks and buffers are draft screening values
for south fulton; zoning_rules.json is the authority
! STREAMS_PIPELINES: stream lines and petroleum pipelines are not
mapped; mapped water, wetlands and floodplain get a 25 ft buffer
i BELOW_COMP_BAND: 3,756 SF per gross acre; Georgia comps run
paving envelope (draft setbacks/buffers, 25 ft from water)
Screening test fit from public data: not a survey, civil design or zoning
determination. Zoning values are draft; detention is a +/-30% estimate;
routes, fire access and grading are indicative.
